The automatic lookup feels right, and the brief “looking up” message makes it clear something is happening. With `https://example.com`, seeing the title and description appear on their own matches what I had in mind.

Before saving, though, I’d want to be able to correct the title and description if the page supplies something unhelpful. I’d also expect the page’s real icon and preview image when available, rather than just a letter.

One concern: a link should still be saveable if the lookup fails. I wouldn’t want a slow or unusual website to leave the Save button permanently unavailable.
